speaker: Unknown_speaker010
text: 15 to nearly 14 million years ago, expansion started. Wait, the Earth began to cool, the autotrophs began to drool, Neanderthals developed tools, we built a wall. We built the pyramids. Math, science, history, and rattled in the mystery of it all started with the Big Bang.

speaker: Leonard
text: Or perhaps destiny. I think it was destiny. Destiny, thy name is Anaheim.

speaker: Shelly
text: My friend's getting married at Disneyland tomorrow. And he has dropped off some papers for Shelly to sign for my dad's estate.

speaker: Sheldon
text: So Missy, what brings you all the way to Texas? The papers could have been mailed. Mom just sent you here to spy on me, didn't she?

speaker: Shelly
text: I guess that's why they call you a genius.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Call me a genius because I'm a genius. Tell Mom that I currently weigh 165 pounds and that I'm having regular bowel movements. Enjoy the wedding. Goodbye.

speaker: Leonard
text: If the wedding's not until tomorrow, why don't you stay with us tonight?

speaker: Shelly
text: Oh, I don't think so. Shelly doesn't like company. Even as little boys, they'd send his imaginary friends home at the end of the day.

speaker: Sheldon
text: They were not friends. They were imaginary colleagues.

speaker: Leonard
text: Look, you're here. We have plenty of room. Come on, Shelly. She's really...

speaker: Sheldon
text: Some what? I don't issue invitations to your mother.

speaker: Shelly
text: It would be nice not to have to drive to Anaheim in rush hour.

speaker: Sheldon
text: And don't ever call me Shelly.

speaker: Leonard
text: So it's settled. You'll stay with us. You're in structure three. Level C.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'll walk you to your car.
